name: Land or Die! 🔥 [SUPERSONIC]
desc:
🚨 CURRENTLY IN BETA — expect bugs, glitches, and ongoing updates
⚠️ WARNING: This game contains flashing lights and rapid camera effects that may trigger seizures in individuals with photosensitive epilepsy and may cause motion sickness.

✈️ Your pilot has mysteriously "passed out" mid-flight… You and your crew must take control of the airplane and guide it to safety!

🎮 Gameplay:
• Switch camera views (V)
• Calm passengers & manage panic
• Fix broken systems & stabilize the plane
• Handle fires, turbulence & in-flight emergencies
• Buy tools from the Supply Shop
• Work together to complete emergency landings

🔥 Expect: engine fires, system failures, chaos, and near-crash landings

💚 Like 👍 and ⭐ Favorite to support development
Join our group for updates!

🛬 Land or Die! is a chaotic multiplayer plane survival game where you handle emergencies, repair systems, and work together to safely land the aircraft before disaster strikes.

⚠️ Land safely… or die. 💀
